up: Find all molecules reported in document CHEMBL5104090. Return the molecule ChEMBL ID, preferred name, max phase, molecule type, and canonical SMILES. Filter the docs table by chembl_id = 'CHEMBL5104090'. Join docs with compound_records on doc_id, then join compound_records with molecule_dictionary on molregno, and with compound_structures on molregno. Apply DISTINCT to the selected columns to avoid duplicates.
sql: SELECT DISTINCT md.chembl_id, md.pref_name, md.max_phase, md.molecule_type, cs.canonical_smiles FROM docs d JOIN compound_records cr ON d.doc_id = cr.doc_id JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON cr.molregno = md.molregno JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE d.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL5104090'
